en.title: Collective nouns
en.summary: A collective noun names a group of people or things as one unit.

paragraphs: A collective noun names a group of people or things as one unit. Team, family, class, committee, audience and government are collective nouns. They are singular in form, but they stand for several members. This causes a choice about the verb.

In British English a collective noun can take a singular or a plural verb. The singular stresses the group as one body. The plural stresses the individual members. American English prefers the singular. Whichever you choose, stay consistent inside the sentence.

blocks.html:
Singular verbPlural verb
The team is winning.The team are arguing.
The class is large.The class are taking notes.
The family is old.The family are all well.
The committee has met.The committee have disagreed.
The staff is small.The staff are on holiday.

paragraphs: Use it and its with a singular verb, and they and their with a plural verb. We say The team lost its first match, or The team lost their first match. We do not mix: The team is losing their match sounds wrong to many speakers.
The words police, people and cattle are always plural, although they name groups. We say The police are here and The people were kind. A police officer is a single person.

items: Wrong: **The police is here.** Right: **The police are here.**
Wrong: **The people was kind.** Right: **The people were kind.**
Wrong: **The team are losing its match.** Right: **The team are losing their match.**

ro.title: Substantive colective
ro.summary: Substantivul colectiv denumește un grup de ființe sau obiecte și cere verbul la singular.

paragraphs: Un substantiv colectiv are formă de singular, dar are înțeles de plural. El denumește o colectivitate de oameni, animale sau lucruri. De exemplu, cuvintele „familie”, „echipă” sau „popor” sunt substantive colective.

În limba română, substantivul colectiv la singular cere acordul cu verbul la singular. Nu folosim verbul la plural când subiectul este un substantiv colectiv la singular. Aceste cuvinte au gen și primesc articol hotărât enclitic (la sfârșit).

blocks.html:
Substantiv colectivFormă cu articol hotărâtExemplu cu verb la singular
familiefamiliaFamilia călătorește mult.
echipăechipaEchipa câștigă trofeul.
poporpoporulPoporul votează astăzi.
grupgrupulGrupul ascultă ghidul.
